en.name: Signature Stir-Fry Spicy Pot
en.blurb: Wok-tossed, dry-fried and deeply numbing. Our house signature.

zh.name: 招牌干锅麻辣
zh.blurb: 大火爆炒，干香麻辣，本店招牌。

en.name: Signature Spicy Malatang
en.blurb: The Sichuan street classic. Numbing, fiery, endlessly customisable.

zh.name: 招牌麻辣烫
zh.blurb: 四川街头经典，麻辣鲜香，随心自选。

en.name: Sichuan Dry Mix
en.blurb: No broth, all sauce. Tossed in chilli, sesame and Sichuan pepper.

zh.name: 四川拌菜
zh.blurb: 无汤底，全靠酱香。辣椒、芝麻与花椒拌匀。

en.name: Pork Bone Soup
en.blurb: Slow-simmered for hours until milky, rich and mellow.

zh.name: 猪骨浓汤
zh.blurb: 慢火熬煮数小时，奶白浓郁，温润醇厚。

en.name: Golden Pickled Soup
en.blurb: Bright, sour and golden. Pickled greens cut straight through the richness.

zh.name: 金汤酸菜
zh.blurb: 金黄酸爽，酸菜解腻，开胃醒神。

en.name: Sweet & Savoury Tomato Soup
en.blurb: Sweet, tangy and gentle. The one everyone agrees on.

zh.name: 香甜番茄汤
zh.blurb: 酸甜温和，不辣不燥，老少皆宜。

en.name: Fragrant Coconut Laksa Soup
en.blurb: Southeast Asia meets Sichuan. Creamy coconut with a slow-building warmth.

zh.name: 香浓椰香叻沙
zh.blurb: 东南亚风味遇上四川，椰香醇厚，辣意渐起。

en.name: Crispy Prawn Spring Rolls
en.blurb: Light, golden, and shatteringly crisp pastry sheets wrapped around a juicy, seasoned prawn filling. The perfect crunchy bite to start your meal.

zh.name: 香脆鲜虾春卷
zh.blurb: 金黄酥脆的薄皮包裹多汁调味虾馅，开胃第一口就要够脆。

en.name: Fried Crispy Pork
en.blurb: Premium pork neck pieces lightly battered and fried to a perfect golden crunch, then tossed in a subtle, aromatic spice seasoning. A wonderful contrast of crispy outside and tender inside.

zh.name: 香酥炸猪颈肉
zh.blurb: 精选猪颈肉薄裹脆浆炸至金黄，再撒上淡淡椒香调味，外酥里嫩。

en.name: Golden Red Bean Sesame Doughnut
en.blurb: Golden, crispy pastry puffs coated in toasted sesame seeds, opening up to a warm, sweet, and smooth red bean paste centre.

zh.name: 金黄芝麻红豆球
zh.blurb: 外层滚满烤香芝麻，咬开是温热细腻的红豆沙。

en.name: Crispy Mochi with Sticky Brown Sugar Glaze
en.blurb: Crispy on the outside with a wonderfully chewy, mochi-like centre, generously drizzled with a rich, sticky brown sugar syrup.

zh.name: 黑糖脆皮麻糬
zh.blurb: 外层酥脆，内里软糯拉丝，淋上浓稠黑糖糖浆。

en.name: Pork and Prawn Wonton Soup
en.blurb: Delicate, handmade wontons packed with juicy pork and prawns, served in a clean, comforting, and clear seasoned broth. Pure comfort in a bowl.

zh.name: 鲜虾猪肉馄饨汤
zh.blurb: 手工薄皮馄饨，猪肉鲜虾双馅，配清爽调味高汤，一碗暖心。

en.name: Pork and Prawn Wonton in Chilli Oil
en.blurb: The same plump pork and prawn wontons, but served floating in a fragrant, fiery house-made chilli oil broth. Slippery, spicy, and incredibly satisfying.

zh.name: 红油抄手
zh.blurb: 同样饱满的鲜虾猪肉馄饨，浸在自制红油里，滑嫩香辣，过瘾。

en.name: Fragrant Shallot Oil & Egg Fried Rice
en.blurb: Fluffy, aromatic jasmine rice wok-fried with eggs and infused with our fragrant, house-made shallot oil. Simple, comforting, and the perfect sidekick to any spicy dish.

zh.name: 葱油蛋炒饭
zh.blurb: 茉莉香米与鸡蛋同炒，淋入自制葱油，简单香口，配辣菜最佳。

en.name: Umami Wild Mushroom Fried Rice
en.blurb: A premium, earthy fried rice tossed with a rich, savoury paste made from Maitake mushrooms. Deeply savoury, vegetarian-friendly, and packed with umami.

zh.name: 野生菌菇炒饭
zh.blurb: 以舞茸菌菇酱翻炒，鲜味浓郁，纯素可享。

en.name: Steamed Jasmine Rice
en.blurb: A simple bowl of perfectly steamed, fragrant jasmine rice to help balance out the bold spices of your meal.

zh.name: 茉莉香米饭
zh.blurb: 一碗蒸得恰好的香米饭，平衡满桌浓烈香辣。
